analyst.summary: CUMI is a well-regarded, market-leading Indian abrasives and refractories maker (Murugappa group) going through a soft patch: an industrial-demand slowdown has kept revenue growth tepid, and a large one-off charge in the most recent quarter pushed reported profit down further, making the trailing valuation look more expensive than it really is on a normalized basis. We rate it a Hold: the franchise quality is solid, but investors should look through the one-off to the underlying, still-modest growth trend before paying up for the stock.
